summary: Sprint 04 (CROMS + GCU365Maintenance integration) e2e validated against the public preview URL. Backend smoke (smoke_sprint04.py, 15 green steps) covers: CROMS check-out (DRAFT) + idempotent replay + IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT (409), CROMS check-in with baselineInspectionSessionId link, CROMS damage-summary returns finalCustomerChargeDecision==NOT_OWNED_BY_DAMAGE_INTELLIGENCE plus checkOut/checkIn ids, CROMS inspection status, Maintenance handoff SENT + idempotent replay + workOrderExecutionOwnedBy==GCU365Maintenance, work-order reference linked (not owned), repair-status with actualRepairCostOwnedBy==GCU365Maintenance and postRepairInspectionRecommended==true for REPAIR_COMPLETED, rejection-reason + additional-evidence (OPEN), handoff-status aggregation with no raw objectPath / /internal/storage leak, security (DI_Admin without integration perms blocked 403), tenant isolation (RIYADAH-DOH-001 service vs TENANT-000001 data -> 404), handoff on unknown damageCaseId -> 404. Frontend /cases/:id renders [data-testid=case-maintenance-context] with Handoffs (REJECTED), Work Orders (WO-1 WORK_ORDER_CREATED + REJECTION INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE), and Repair Status (REPAIR_COMPLETED cost ref: MNT-COST-1). Zero console/page errors.
verified_acceptance_criteria: CROMS check-out creates inspectionType=CHECK_OUT, status=DRAFT (stores CROMS refs).
Idempotency replay: same X-Idempotency-Key + same payload returns same inspectionSessionId.
Idempotency conflict: same X-Idempotency-Key + different payload -> 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.
CROMS check-in creates CHECK_IN session and echoes baselineInspectionSessionId.
CROMS damage-summary returns checkOut/checkIn ids, damageSummaryStatus, damageCaseIds, comparisonStatus and finalCustomerChargeDecision==NOT_OWNED_BY_DAMAGE_INTELLIGENCE.
CROMS inspection status returns status==DRAFT for the check-out session.
Maintenance handoff for eligible case -> status SENT + workOrderExecutionOwnedBy==GCU365Maintenance; idempotent replay returns same maintenanceHandoffId; unknown damageCaseId -> 404.
Maintenance work-order-references stores reference (linked==true, not owned).
Maintenance repair-status-updates stores actualRepairCostReference as reference only; actualRepairCostOwnedBy==GCU365Maintenance; postRepairInspectionRecommended==true for REPAIR_COMPLETED.
Maintenance handoff-status aggregation returns handoffs[], references[], repairStatusUpdates[] with no raw objectPath / /internal/storage URLs.
Security: DI_Admin (no integration perms) hitting /integrations/croms is rejected with 403.
Tenant isolation: RIYADAH-DOH-001 integration service gets 404 on TENANT-000001 damage-summary, inspection status and handoff-status.

FRONTEND /cases/:id renders [data-testid=case-maintenance-context] with handoffs, work orders, rejection, and repair-status entries when maintenanceContext is non-empty; case-status-select + case-status-submit present.
critical_code_review_comments: smoke_sprint04.py already covers all Sprint-04 invariants including idempotency replay/conflict, ownership-boundary fields, tenant isolation, security denial, no-URL-leak, and the Maintenance handoff 404 path; the implementation strictly preserves CROMS / Maintenance ownership (finalCustomerChargeDecision and actualRepairCostOwnedBy correctly returned as NOT_OWNED_BY_DAMAGE_INTELLIGENCE / GCU365Maintenance).

Outbound CROMS notify_damage_summary_ready and Maintenance submit_handoff are CLIENT STUBS by design (CromsClientStub / MaintenanceClientStub record intent only); this is expected for Sprint-04 and documented in the request — no real external call is made.

Frontend case-maintenance-context section is conditional on at least one of handoffs/workOrders/repairStatusUpdates being non-empty, which matches the intended UX (no empty placeholder when the case has no Maintenance interaction yet).

success_rate.backend: 100% (15/15 smoke steps incl. idempotency, ownership-boundary, tenant isolation, security)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on the executed AC (maintenance integration section + status controls)
